subject: Approval request: atypical sign‑on + equity refresh for Olivia Grant
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: atypical sign‑on + equity refresh for Olivia Grant

Hi Stephanie —

Following up on Olivia Grant (candidate, ex-AI infra at Vector Labs). Talent forwarded her final counterthis morning; recruiting recommends an exception to the calibrated compensation band for Senior LLM Engineer to close. Key points: 

- Current band cap for Senior LLM Eng: $185,000 base.
- Offer we want to present: $210,000 base (≈13.5% above cap), $35,000 one-time sign‑on, equity 0.6% initial grant + 0.25% one‑time refresh at 12 months (refresh is above the usual plan).
- Candidate has a competing in-flight offer that will convert in 72 hours unless we move.
- Win criteria: speed to offer, sign‑on to offset risk, and a short-term refresh to improve retention.

Rationale: Olivia has a rare mix of production inference and large-model training experience; hiring manager (Asha) sees this as mission-critical for our private deployment roadmap. We ran comps (see attached comp-band-comparator.xlsx) — there is a market premium for folks with her profile.

Asking: approval to present the proposed package (base + sign‑on + 12‑mo refresh). If approved, I will issue a redline of the offer (attached draft: redwood_offer_package_v3.pdf) and request Finance to confirm spend. If not approved, suggested fallback: $200k base + $30k sign‑on and standard equity (no refresh).

Urgency: Need a final decision by 5pm PT 2025‑07‑14 to meet candidate timeline.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if useful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood_offer_package_v3.pdf (offer memo draft), comp-band-comparator.xlsx (market comps)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: atypical sign‑on + equity refresh for Olivia Grant

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the writeup and the comps. Quick thoughts: I'm supportive of being competitive here given the skillset and timing, but we need explicit signoff from Markus (budget/role owner) and Finance (Laura) on the refresh mechanics.

Two items to clarify before final OK:
- Is the refresh time‑based (12 months) with pro‑rata vesting, or a performance tied refresh?
- Can we add a 6‑month retention clawback for the sign‑on to reduce risk?

Markus — would you confirm budget runway and that this hire is prioritized over other open infra roles?
Laura — asking you to confirm whether the one‑time refresh can be booked against hiring budget versus stretch comp pool. If you prefer, we can route as a partial sign‑on + retention bonus structure.

If Markus/Laura are fine, I'm happy to approve the proposed package and let Recruiting move quickly.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Head of Talent Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: atypical sign‑on + equity refresh for Olivia Grant

Copying my notes inline for clarity.

Stephanie — budget runway: confirmed from Infrastructure headcount plan (Q3 hiring reserve). This role is prioritized for private deployment roadmap. We can absorb the incremental base (to $210k) and sign‑on from the team pool.

On the refresh: agree to a one‑time equity refresh at 12 months, but with the following conditions:
- Refresh vests over 24 months with a 6‑month cliff.
- Refresh instrument to be structured as time‑vested RSUs (no performance kicker).
- Sign‑on subject to a 6‑month clawback if employee leaves before 6 months.

Please update offer doc to reflect the clawback language and the 12‑month refresh vesting schedule. Laura — if Finance confirms that the refresh can be earmarked to the Q3 hiring reserve, we are green.

Approve in principle pending Laura's confirmation and the updated offer doc.

—Markus
Markus Klein | VP, Infrastructure Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@gmail.com>
Date: 2025-07-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Updated offer + candidate timeline (Olivia Grant)

Folks — quick update and final packet attached. Per Markus' direction I've updated the offer language: 6‑month sign‑on clawback (pro‑rated), 12‑month refresh vested over 24 months with 6‑month cliff. Laura confirmed the refresh charge to the Q3 hiring reserve this morning.

Olivia is happy to see the changes and asked for the updated offer by EOD PT today. I also requested a soft verbal decision window of 48 hours once she receives the redlined offer. Candidate is looped above for transparency.

Attaching: redwood_offer_package_v3_FINAL.pdf (sent to candidate), comp-band-comparator.xlsx (final).

If no objections, I'll send and request signature.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_offer_package_v3_FINAL.pdf, comp-band-comparator.xlsx
